name: Market Shift
description: External conditions suddenly change; assumptions must be re-evaluated.

name: Resource Withdrawal
description: A key resource or support is removed mid-process.

name: Stakeholder Conflict Event
description: A new conflicting priority emerges from a stakeholder group.

name: Regulatory Constraint
description: New rule or limitation affects previously valid strategies.

name: Information Asymmetry Spike
description: Some teams receive additional hidden information; others do not.

name: Investor Pullout
description: Your primary funding source disappears unexpectedly.

name: Regulatory Shock
description: New regulations restrict your original design.
